scope: Complete construction and acceptance of one explicitly designed gravity-sewer collector: 600 m of selected PVC-U SN8 OD 200 pipe at slope 0.007. Pipe-system materials, trench and bedding quantities, manholes, fittings, consumables, labor, mechanisms, testing, records and logistics are project inputs. Pumping stations, building drainage and unrelated utility networks are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved water-and-sewer design organization, geotechnical engineer, pipe-system manufacturer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved plan and longitudinal profile with route length, pipe material, stiffness, diameter and slope
approved pipe, socket seal, fitting and lubricant schedule
approved trench, bedding, surround, backfill and excess-soil quantities
installation method with labor and mechanism quantities
delivery and excess-soil or packaging removal plan
conditional dewatering, shoring and road-restoration schedules
supplier pipe-stick length and approved retained spare length

rules.totalNeed: installed net length + retained spare length

forbiddenClaims: trench or material quantities derived from generic length coefficients
automatic fittings, dewatering, shoring or road restoration
universal pipe spare or supplier stick length
pumping station or building drainage included
